Class ProviderSpec

java.lang.Object
opennlp.tools.util.ext.ProviderSpec
public final class ProviderSpec extends Object
Describes what a Provider should create: an optional location, such as a model file, and string options. Instances are immutable.
Since:
3.0.0
See Also:

    • of

      public static ProviderSpec of(Path location, Map<String,String> options)
      Creates a spec for a file or directory with options. A relative path is resolved against the working directory of the running process when the spec is created, so a spec that is kept in a static field must not be created from a relative path. The file system is not read, so the location of a directory carries no trailing separator and a path holding .. is kept as it is.
      Parameters:
      location - The file or directory. Must not be null.
      options - The options. Must not be null, an option name must not be null or blank and an option value must not be null.
      Returns:
      The spec. Never null.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if location is null, or if options is invalid.

    • locationEndsWith

      public boolean locationEndsWith(String suffix)
      Checks whether the last path segment of the location ends with a suffix, ignoring case. A query and a fragment are not part of the comparison. For an opaque URI, such as jar:file:/models.jar!/model.onnx, the scheme-specific part is used as path. This is a convenience for routing a request to a provider, not a validation of the location.
      Parameters:
      suffix - The suffix, for example .onnx. Must not be null or empty.
      Returns:
      true if this spec has a location and its last path segment ends with suffix.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if suffix is null or empty.
